name: DUMBBELL CONCENTRATION CURL LEFT
introduce:
Sit on a bench with your feet wider than shoulder width apart. Hold a dumbbell in your left hand. 

Extend your left arm and put your elbow against your inner thigh. 

Bend your left arm and raise the dumbbell up, then lower it down.

tips.text: Please prepare a dumbbell that you feel comfortable with.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Exhale as you raise the dumbbell, and inhale as you lower it.
